title: FAO Simple methods for aquaculture — Water: Estimates of water requirements, §2.1

retrieval.scope: Official full chapter body via browser, including §2.1 tables

facts.statement: Puddled clay and loamy clay are listed at about 1 mm/day seepage, rather than zero.
New ponds initially lose more water; water losses depend on soil texture and structure.

limits: These are fish-pond guidance rates, not measurements on the island raw clay or a 20 mm lining. No site-specific calibration.
Do not transplant 1 mm/day to the simulation as a measured constant.
